profileIsolation.userDataDirectory: unique validated child of the OS temporary directory
profileIsolation.sessionDataDirectory: unique validated child of the OS temporary directory
profileIsolation.cleanupPolicy: remove the validated per-run root after Electron exits

fixture.content: synthetic neutral-gray field with phase-shifted vertical/horizontal high-chroma edges and a 4x4 checkerboard; baseline JPEG padded with APP2 segments to the 20 MiB source limit; no user data

independentPixelOracle.decoder: Windows System.Drawing / GDI+ independent JPEG decode

jpegJsPixelOracle.executionContext: Electron parent process before worker samples

worker.recyclingPolicy: one fresh process per uncached image larger than the 32 MiB decoded cache

jpegCapacityEstimate.includes: encoded input copies, coefficient blocks, component lines, RGB intermediate, RGBA output, JPEG tables, Huffman trees, and decoded comments

latency.timingScope: fresh utility process ready, then request post through 64000000-byte RGBA response receipt

stageTimingDefinitions.chunkSendMs: utility process first chunk send through receipt of the final chunk ACK
stageTimingDefinitions.requestToFirstChunkMessageMs: parent postMessage through receipt of the first raw pixel chunk
stageTimingDefinitions.parentChunkTransferMs: parent receipt of first raw pixel chunk through validated end message

latency.responsePayloadBytesMeaning: sum of raw RGBA IPC chunk bytes (transportBytes)

limitations: Fresh-process synthetic 16000000-pixel samples are diagnostic; they do not satisfy the T05 100-sample controlled desktop timing gates or measure end-user paste latency.

The JPEG is a generated baseline image with synthetic APP2 padding to exercise the encoded-source ceiling; progressive JPEG, real EXIF/ICC metadata, other image content, UI responsiveness and original clipboard conversion are not covered.
No fixture was rejected by the decoder's internal capacity guard in this sample set; this does not establish a universal process-memory ceiling.

PeakWorkingSet64 is the OS-reported peak for each fresh process; private bytes are sampled every 100 ms and around each decode, so shorter private-memory peaks can be missed. These observations do not prove a hard ceiling for every decode.
No clipboard, target window, physical input, installed package, helper, or rollback behavior was exercised. P15 and full T04 acceptance remain open.
This harness sets unique userData and sessionData paths under the OS temporary directory and removes the validated per-run root only after Electron exits.

Decoded RGB values were compared at 1024 coordinates with the independent Windows System.Drawing/GDI+ JPEG decoder using a maximum per-channel tolerance of 8. This is a sampled oracle, not a full-image pixel hash. The dense ROI is 32x32 at (1024,2960). The 8-channel tolerance was previously calibrated only against the deterministic 4:4:4 jpeg-js fixture; non-4:4:4 output remains diagnostic and cannot pass from this threshold.

The optional pinned jpeg-js full-frame oracle is a differential reference to the existing decoder path, not an independent implementation. It runs in the Electron parent before worker samples and retains a 64,000,000-byte RGBA buffer; that memory is excluded from each utilityProcess PeakWorkingSet64 measurement.
